ops.text: SuBA (Mowat et al., 2026) instead derives the total budget from the prompt length $L$, growing it as $L^{0.61}$ so that longer requests keep a smaller fraction of their cache.

new_bib.text: F. Mowat, E. Cowan, I. Sadowska, R. Menon, and K. Ballantyne (2026). Lossless KV budgets from long prompts to long reasoning traces: a length-controlled study of cache eviction. arXiv preprint.
